title: Three Stars
text: Three Stars. it does serve its purpose

product_metadata.title: La Crosse Technology WS-8117U-IT-AL Atomic Wall Clock with Indoor/Outdoor Temperature
features: Atomic Time & date. Transmission range: Up to 330 Feet . Outdoor temperature range: -39.8°F to 139.8 °F (-39.8°C to 59.8 °C)
Brushed-aluminum atomic wall clock with time, date, and temperature functions
Radio-calibrated for accuracy to within 1 second; automatic self-adjustment
Indoor and remote temperatures, moon phase readings, and alarm with snooze
12- or 24-hour clock modes; time zone setting; remote transmission up to 330 feet
12-1/4 by 8 by 1-1/4 inches; takes 4 AA batteries; wall-mount or tabletop; 1-year warranty
description: Wirelessly monitor the indoor and outdoor temperatures with the digital atomic wall clock with indoor & outdoor temperature in brushed steel finish from La Crosse technology. The ws-8117u-it-c features 12 Moon phase icons, atomic time and date, a perpetual calendar & 4 languages (EN, FR, ger & SP), and automatically updates for daylight savings. Dimensions - Display: 11.50 L x 1.00 W x 7.75 H Inches Sensor: 1.50 L x 0.83 W x 5.05 H Inches
